Blinded English phoneme test

Use headphones. Identify the word you hear. Engine identity and target answers are hidden. Choose what you hear; choose Unclear if you cannot identify it. Start quietly and use a comfortable headphone volume. These are research stimuli, not a released voice.

48 trials total, or 16 per register. Answers are saved in this browser; completed trials are skipped. Export includes every completed register. You can replay each clip. “Unclear” counts as an unsuccessful identification. No results are sent anywhere. Export the JSON and return it to this conversation for grading. Keep a copy before clearing browser data.
